clue.text: Settled tendency to provide clothing

definitions.meaning: a fixed custom or practice someone keeps to
a garment such as a monk's or rider's dress

explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both a routine practice and distinctive dress, as in a nun's or riding outfit.

clue.text: Make haste, say, and beat the storm

indicators.note: say signals that the word is spoken, giving its sound only

parts.note: to make haste is to hurry
to cane is to beat with a stick

explanation.surface: Advice to rush and outrun bad weather.
explanation.definitionFit: A tropical cyclone with very strong winds is a violent storm.

clue.text: Surrounded originators of British ecology group

indicators.note: originators are the first letters, starting each of the two words

parts.note: a set is a group

explanation.surface: Founders of a green pressure group in Britain were besieged.
explanation.definitionFit: Besieged or hemmed in on all sides, as by troubles.

clue.text: A revolutionary device, one admits

parts.note: revolutionary suggests rebels, but the device literally revolves, letting people through one at a time

explanation.definitionFit: A rotating gate at a stadium or station entrance lets people pass singly.

clue.text: Novel sort of shirt is a tailed one

annotationWithheld.why: Clue held and printed as 'Novel sort of shirt is a tailed one (9)'; no parse gives the letters of the answer, and 'shirt' does not anagram to it, so a word looks misprinted or the clue is garbled.
annotationWithheld.clue: Novel sort of shirt is a tailed one

clue.text: Deviation from, rule — but honour a student in any case

indicators.note: any case means the word any acts as a casing around the other pieces

parts.note: OM is the Order of Merit, a British honour
L is a learner driver's plate, a student

explanation.surface: A breach of the rules, though it is an award for any learner.
explanation.definitionFit: An irregularity or departure from the normal pattern.

clue.text: War-dance for chirpy characters? About right

indicators.note: about means the letters are turned around into another order

explanation.surface: A tribal dance done by cheerful folk, roughly right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'characters' points to the letters of 'chirpy', which are shuffled together with R.
explanation.definitionFit: A Greek armed dance of ancient times, also giving its name to a metrical foot.

clue.text: This publication is by a girl

parts.note: Sue is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A magazine number credited to a young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: A single edition of a periodical is one number of it.

clue.text: Involve a change: in pace limit

indicators.note: a change of the two words means their letters are rearranged

explanation.definitionFit: To show someone is concerned in a crime is to draw them in.

clue.text: They're barely recognizable when out of gear

definitions.text: They're barely recognizable when out of gear

parts.words: They're barely recognizable when out of gear
parts.note: out of gear sounds like a car engine, but gear is clothing, and barely hints at bare skin

explanation.definitionFit: Unclothed figures, as in paintings or life classes.

clue.text: Its resources can be tapped in the main

definitions.text: Its resources can be tapped in the main

parts.words: Its resources can be tapped in the main
parts.note: the main is a water main, so the resources are stored water drawn off through pipes, not a mainland

explanation.definitionFit: A large artificial lake stores water that is then piped to homes through the mains supply.

clue.text: Of good taste and said to be soft-hearted

indicators.note: soft-hearted is read as having the soft letter at its heart, so P goes into the middle of said

parts.note: taken as written
P (piano) is the musical abbreviation for soft

explanation.surface: Someone praised as tasteful and kind-natured.
explanation.definitionFit: Something with a pleasant flavour is savoury and palatable; the word is a formal synonym for tasty.

clue.text: Stress of one light-weight country

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
ct is the abbreviation for carat, a small unit of weight for gems
US is the United States

explanation.surface: Tension felt by a small nation of little influence.
explanation.walkthrough: The held text dropped 'light-weight'; the printed page restores it, giving the CT piece.
explanation.definitionFit: In prosody the rhythmic beat or accent on a syllable is its stress.

clue.text: Lithe cats' crazy games

indicators.note: crazy says the letters of the two words are jumbled madly into a new order

explanation.definitionFit: Track and field sports are collectively called games, as at a school sports meeting.

clue.text: Sourness experienced by some who have a drop?

definitions.text: Sourness experienced by some who have a drop?

parts.words: Sourness experienced by some who have a drop?
parts.note: a drop suggests a fall or a tipple, but it is an acid drop, the sharp boiled sweet, so the sourness is its taste

explanation.definitionFit: Sharpness of taste comes from acid content, the quality chemists and cooks measure as tartness.

clue.text: Form of gelatin serves as component of barometer?

definitions.meaning: a pure gelatine made from fish bladders
split into three words it says the mercury sits inside a tube of glass

explanation.definitionFit: A clear fish gelatine used for clarifying beer, and, split up, the mercury's place in a tube.

clue.text: Range used by navigators

definitions.meaning: scope or extent, as in the reach of a voice
the magnetic instrument a sailor steers by

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both extent or scope and the needle instrument showing north for steering.

clue.text: Mother and son making riot? Awkward

parts.note: ma is mother
a lad is a boy, a son

indicators.note: making suggests the word riot is shaped into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A mother and boy causing a disturbance, clumsily.
explanation.definitionFit: Clumsy and inept, lacking skill in handling things.

clue.text: Archaic opinions pronounced by the judiciary

definitions.meaning: an old sense of the word is a judgment or view
punishments a judge passes on convicts

explanation.definitionFit: An old sense is a judgment or view held; today it is a punishment a judge passes.

clue.text: Chap in Eastern team demanding immediate attention

parts.note: XI is eleven, the size of a cricket or football side
a gent is a gentleman, a chap

explanation.surface: A fellow in a side from the east who keeps insisting on being noticed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is only a link here: the pieces run side by side, team then chap.
explanation.definitionFit: Something urgent and pressing calls for action at once.

clue.text: A sewer maybe protected by this cover

definitions.text: A sewer maybe protected by this cover

parts.words: A sewer maybe protected by this cover
parts.note: sewer looks like a drain, but it is a person who sews, whose finger is shielded

explanation.definitionFit: A metal cap worn on the fingertip to push a needle while stitching.

clue.text: Old flaw leads to destruction of one warship

parts.note: gall in an old sense is a blemish or fault, like a sore rubbed by harness

indicators.note: destruction breaks the word one up so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An old defect causes a fighting ship to be lost.
explanation.walkthrough: 'warship' might seem to belong with 'one' as the destroyed vessel, but 'one' is the anagram fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: A large sailing vessel of the sixteenth century used in war and trade, especially by Spain.

clue.text: Inside information is the essence of the best original work

indicators.note: inside means one piece sits within the other pieces

parts.note: gen is British slang for information

indicators.note: the essence is the core, the middle letters of the word

explanation.surface: Insider knowledge is the heart of the finest creative work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Inside information' reads as one phrase, but 'Inside' is the container indicator.
explanation.definitionFit: The first book of the Bible, about the creation, is the beginning or origin of things.

clue.text: Quota of Russian fighters going abroad

parts.note: MiG jets are Russian fighter aircraft
a ration is an allotted share

explanation.surface: A limited allocation of Russian jets sent overseas.
explanation.definitionFit: Moving to another country to live is the act of relocation abroad, as birds do seasonally.

clue.text: Enchanting, this roundabout way of entertaining the young

definitions.text: this roundabout way of entertaining the young
definitions.meaning: The ... Roundabout was a famous British children's television programme

explanation.definitionFit: Bewitching or charming; and the first word of a classic British children's TV show title.

clue.text: Letter from a bilingual pharmacist

indicators.note: from shows the letters are lifted out of the run of two words

explanation.surface: A note from a pharmacist who speaks two languages.
explanation.definitionFit: The first character of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: Number of animals conveyed in a vehicle

definitions.meaning: a herd or flock being moved along together
the past tense of steering a car

explanation.definitionFit: A herd driven as a body is one sense; the other is the past tense of driving a car.

clue.text: Flag made of gold lace

definitions.meaning: the iris plant, also called a flag
lace made of gold or silver thread

explanation.definitionFit: An iris whose root gives a scent, and an old kind of embroidered metallic lace.

clue.text: Doctor without artist's power of apprehension

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the doctor goes around the artist

parts.note: GP is a general practitioner
RA is a Royal Academician, a painter; with the possessive it gives RAS

explanation.surface: A doctor lacking an artist's understanding.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like lacking, but here it means outside, as in old usage.
explanation.definitionFit: Comprehension or understanding, as in having a firm hold on a subject.

clue.text: See Southwark, for example

definitions.meaning: the diocese governed by a bishop
Southwark is a district of south London that gives its name to an Anglican diocese

explanation.definitionFit: A diocese or see is the office and territory of a bishop, Southwark being one in London.

clue.text: Their holders may have a rattling good time!

definitions.text: Their holders may have a rattling good time!

parts.words: Their holders may have a rattling good time!
parts.note: a rattling good time sounds like fun, but the holders literally keep a clicking rhythm with them in their hands

explanation.definitionFit: Spanish dancers hold pairs of clicking wooden shells to beat time.

clue.text: Head of Technology seeks work

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter

parts.note: to seek is to ask for

explanation.surface: A technology chief looking for employment.
explanation.definitionFit: Jobs or pieces of assigned labour.
